name: 7th Memory
source:
Main heroine becomes cultural festival executive committee member. Four acquaintances also get different positions for organizing this festival, so young people have a lot of time to hang out together with five of them. They go on a training camp to the forest and ask directions in a western style isolated mansion. Can they discover mansion's mystery and escape safely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主人公成为文化祭执行委员会成员。她的四名熟人也在祭典筹备中担任不同职务，于是五名年轻人有了许多共同相处的时间。他们前往森林参加集训，并到一座与世隔绝的西式宅邸问路。他们能否发现宅邸的秘密并平安逃脱？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
